programme.desc: Soprano Alisa Fedorenko (Russia, 1999) and pianist Evgenii Sergeev (Russia, 1986) perform ‘Mandoline’ and ‘À Clymène’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Cinq melodies “de Venise”, Op. 58; ‘Lied der Delphine’ from Franz Schubert’s Zwei Szenen aus dem Schauspiel ‘Lacrimas’, D. 857; ‘Son’ (A dream) from Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Six Romances, Op.

programme.title: The Boy with the Wig: Kids on Mozart
programme.desc: The Boy with the Wig - Kids on Mozart explores children’s fascination with the composer. The 30-minute film by Claus Wischmann features boys and girls aged between eight and eleven recounting his life through humour and serious interpretations of Mozart’s biography. Discover Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart through the eyes of children.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Ukrainian conductor Kirill Karabits leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a stunning performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 4. The soloist is soprano Lucy Crowe. Mahler’s Fourth Symphony opens with the sound of sleighbells and melodies of childlike innocence. But between this deceptively playful opening and the serene finale – a child’s vision of Heaven – lies a world of profound emotion and beauty.

programme.title: Works by Gluck, Bach and Mozart
programme.desc: Venezuelan-born conductor Giovanni Guzzo leads the Camerata Fundación EDP of the Reina Sofía School of Music in a spirited concert. The program opens with the ethereal ‘Danza degli spiriti beati’ (Dance of the Blessed Spirits) from Christoph Willibald Gluck’s opera Orfeo ed Euridice, featuring flutist Matthew Raymond Origel. The concert continues with vocal masterworks, including J.S.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: J. S. Bach - Arias, solos, and duets
programme.desc: Baritone Matthias Goerne teams up with violinist Vilde Frang, cellist Nicolas Altstaedt, flutist Stathis Karapanos, and harpsichordist Michaela Hasselt in this program dedicated to the music of J. S. Bach. They perform baritone arias from Bach’s most beautiful cantatas, as well as solo pieces and duets. On the program are Sonata No.

programme.title: Liszt’s Concerto No. 1 And Mahler’s Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: American ‘Conductor Laureate’ Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a program of romantic masterworks. The concert opens with Franz Liszt’s Piano Concerto No. 1, featuring the brilliant Czech pianist Lukáš Vondrácek as soloist. The evening concludes with the emotional journey of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 5. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on May 15, 2022.

programme.title: Chopin - Ballade No. 4, Op. 52
programme.desc: Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda performs Frédéric Chopin's technically challenging Ballade No. 4 in F minor, Op. 52. Completed in 1842, this piece is celebrated as a masterpiece within the Romantic piano repertoire, renowned for its intricate structure and profound emotional depth. This performance was recorded at the stunning baroque palace Villa Contarini in Piazzola sul Brenta, Italy, in 2006.

programme.title: Closed - A Ballet from Real Life
programme.desc: Many people live in a closed world. What happens to them when they step onto an arena where they can be themselves, free of their usual roles and status? In the film Closed we encounter four completely different people who once a week leave their everyday lives and get together in a closed café, where they get the opportunity and help to relax and momentarily distance themselves from reality.

programme.title: The 12 Cellists of the Berliner Philharmoniker
programme.desc: Since 1972 the 12 Cellists of the Berliner Philharmoniker have been a prominent institution in international musical life. Listeners around the world are invariably fascinated by the wide range of the unique and intoxicating timbres that these twelve cellos can produce, whether they are playing classical music, jazz, tango or avant-garde. Their mixture of seriousness and humour, of depth and lightness, appeals to audiences of all ages.

programme.title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók’s best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 21 - III
programme.desc: Julijana Sarac performs the first/third movement of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 21 (“Waldstein”). The work was completed in 1804 and is considered one of Beethoven's greatest and most technically challenging piano sonatas.

programme.title: Ravel - Ma mère l'Oye
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - The Nutcracker
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's The Nutcracker is one of the best known and most beloved pieces from the composer. The music has inspired many choreographers to the tell the colourful Christmas fairy-tale of E. T. A. Hoffmann and Alexandre Dumas senior in the language of dance. Ben Stevenson is to this day considered one of the most important influencers of the American ballet art.

The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. programme.title: Brahms - Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in a wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, violinist Tedi Papavrami, violist Lyda Chen-Argerich, cellist Mischa Maisky, and pianist Lily Maisky perform Johannes Brahms’s Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60.

programme.title: Verdi - La traviata
programme.desc: This production of Giuseppe Verdi's popular opera La Traviata was performed outdoors at the St. Margarethen Festival in 2008 by the Slovak Philharmonic Orchestra under the direction of Ernst Märzendorfer. Soloists Kristiane Kaiser, Magdalena Anna Hofmann, and Stefanie Kopinits perform in a striking physical setting against the backdrop of the Austrian mountains.

programme.title: J. S. Bach: Mass in B minor, BWV 232
programme.desc: In this concert, Herbert Blomstedt conducts the Gewandhaus Orchestra and Kammerchor for the last time as the Gewandhaus Music Director at the Leipzig Bachfest 2005. After seven successful years in Leipzig, the maestro performs J. S. Bach's Mass in B minor (BWV 232), one of the greatest works of church music ever written. Soloists are Ruth Ziesak (soprano), Anna Larsson (alto), Christoph Genz (tenor), and Dietrich Henschel (bass).

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Debussy – La Mer
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Claude Debussy’s ‘La Mer’.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Le sacre du printemps
programme.desc: Maestro Bernard Haitink leads the Berliner Philharmoniker in a performance of Igor Stravinsky's Le sacre du printemps (‘The Rite of Spring’). Stravinksy composed the ballet’s score in 1913 for Sergei Diaghilev's itinerant ballet company Ballets Russes. The work’s sensational première at the Théâtre des Champs-Élysées in Paris caused a riot in the audience in response to the avant-garde nature of the music and choreography.

programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Sounds like Christmas
programme.desc: Set in the magnificent Cistercian Monastery Schulpforte near Naumburg, Germany, Sounds like Christmas combines festive music with the spontaneity and freshness of jazz. This Christmas program is the musical encounter between soprano Angelika Kirchschlager and jazz trumpeter Tomasz Stanko.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. The concert opens with Sergei Prokofiev's Overture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34. After this, Thomas Zehetmair stars as solo violinist in Prokofiev Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63. The second part of the concert is features music by Igor Stravinsky.

programme.title: Brahms - A German Requiem, Op. 45
programme.desc: In this concert recorded in November 2016 at the magnificent Baroque basilica of Saint Florian, Austria – once the home of Anton Bruckner – the Wiener Singverein, the Cleveland Orchestra and its principal conductor Franz Welser-Möst pare down all traces of bombast wherever emotions could easily run out of control. Brahms' Ein Deutsches Requiem, Op.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Duparc, Schumann a. o.
programme.desc: Baritone Geng Lee (China, 1994) and pianist Nils Basters (Germany, 1989) perform Henri Duparc’s Chanson triste; ‘Ein Jüngling liebt ein Mädchen’ and ‘Am leuchtenden Sommermorgen’ from Robert Schumann’s Dichterliebe, Op.

programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 2 BWV 1015
programme.desc: Johann Sebastian Bach probably wrote this set of six Sonatas for Violin and Harpsichord during his time as chapel master in Köthen. Presumably, he wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig. Maybe this is why these pieces are well playable for amateurs, while every sonata still has the finesse that can offer a challenge to professional musicians.

programme.title: Mozart - Gran partita
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Serenade No. 10 for winds in B-flat major, K. 361, also known as the ‘Gran Partita’.

programme.title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo.

programme.title: Bach – Italian Concerto And Chaconne (arr. Busoni)
programme.desc: Italian classical pianist Costanza Principe (1993) started playing the piano at age 6, making her public debut at age 7. Before long she would be performing as a soloist with numerous prestigious orchestras in Italy, the UK, France, and South America.

programme.title: Couperin - Leçons de ténèbres
programme.desc: The French soprano Hanna Bayodi and the Portuguese Ana Quintans join today the Ricercar Consort. The music is by maestro Couperin ‘le Grand’, who just prior to his death had his printer’s licence renewed in order to be able to publish all his music. However, Couperin’s family neglected to pursue the matter, which resulted in the loss of six sets of leçons de ténèbres, among other things. Fortunately, three sets were preserved.

programme.title: Mosaïque Project - Canadian Piano Quartets
programme.desc: This very special concert event celebrates the diversity and richness of Canada through the eyes and ears of its people. Ensemble Made in Canada’s Mosaique Project features a commissioned suite of piano quartets by 14 Canadian composers, each inspired by a region of our vast country. Their album release and two-year National tour culminate in St. Catharines’ stunning Partridge Hall!

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: The Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester was founded in 1986 at the initiative of Claudio Abbado and has since become the world’s best youth orchestra. Named after the great composer, the programme is marked by the special relationship between the maestro and the young orchestra, as well as their special relationship to Gustav Mahler.

programme.title: The Divan Orchestra from the Alhambra
programme.desc: Millions of television viewers in Germany, France, Portugal, Greece and Finland experienced live the moving open-air concert within the highly symbolic surrounding of the Alhambra in Granada. Music as a language of peace – this vision unifies the young musicians of the West-Eastern Divan Orchestra who come from Israel, Palestine, Syria, Jordan, Egypt and Europe.

programme.title: Liszt - Elegies No. 1 and 2 (S. 130 And 131)
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Franz Liszt’s Two Elegies for cello and piano. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.desc: Uwe Scholz, one of the most important choreographers of the 20th century, created two interpretations of Igor Stravinsky’s Le Sacre du Printemps for the Leipzig Ballet. Sacre I, for one dancer, can be interpreted as a bleak and oppressive dance about Scholz’ own life. This unique solo is performed by Giovanni Di Palma to the four-handed piano version.

programme.title: Dvorák - Rusalka
programme.desc: Bulgarian conductor Pavel Baleff conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Opéra de Limoges in a performance of Antonín Dvorák’s lyric fairytale opera Rusalka (1900). The work’s libretto is written by Czech poet Jaroslav Kvapil. Rusalka, an elusive water nymph, falls in love with the Prince, who happens to swim in her lake. Rusalka longs to become human herself so that she can be together with the Prince.

programme.title: Waldbühne 1997 - St. Petersburg White Night
programme.desc: The 1997 edition of the Waldbühne concert is dedicated to Russian composers. The Berliner Philharmoniker, directed by Zubin Mehta, kicks off the evening with the opening of Mikhail Glinka's opera Ruslan and Ludmila, after which Daniel Barenboim takes center stage to perform Tchaikovsky's Piano Concerto No. 1 and Chopin's Waltz in D flat major, op. 64 No. 1.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a performance of Robert Schumann’s Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony’. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann’s four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

Começam a morar juntos e ela acaba por descobrir algo que ele tem mantido em segredo: ele tem um irmão gémeo, igualmente psicanalista, com quem ela também se vai cruzar.

Aqui, a tradição é viva e respira-se em todos os corredores.Neste episódio do “Feira Semanal”, Marcos Pinto percorre o terreiro onde a feira acontece há séculos, num cenário que mistura o encanto medieval com a simplicidade do dia-a-dia.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Amigos para sempre T1 - Ep. 26
programme.desc: Eren, Seda, Merve e Yunus são quatro amigos que se conheceram há um ano, quando estudavam na universidade. No primeiro ano de aula, Seda conhece seu amigo de infância Gizem. programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 39
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Bakolo Music International - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Django Reinhardt Tribute: Beets And Rosenberg
programme.desc: The treasured compositions of guitarist Django Reinhardt, the founding father of hot club jazz, are engraved in everyone's memory. Although Reinhardt missed two fingers of his left hand, his virtuoso technique was unrivalled. Dutch guitarist Stochelo Rosenberg and pianist Peter Beets now have the pleasure to bring Django’s music back to life with their infectious improvisations.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Bertus Borgers And The Young Retro's
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: H. Jones, J. Woode, C. Lucas - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Seine Sessions: Funk And Afro
programme.desc: The term 'jam-session' was born in the 1920s, when black and white musicians gathered in smoke-filled bars after their respective concerts to enjoy the kind of jazz they could not play in traditional sets. Bing Crosby was a regular at these sessions, and had fun marking the first and third beats of musical phrases by clapping hands, which the musicians call 'jammin' the beat'.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: Blossom
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. The Morgenland Chamber Orchestra has been an integral part of the Morgenland Festival since 2009.

programme.title: It's Up To You
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Saluzzi, Mariano And Dauner live in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Dino Saluzzi, one of Argentina's tango music masters, has been building his legacy since the mid-1980s. His accordion-like bandoneon defines Argentina's tango music. Saluzzi has explored many paths—paths along which he has rarely travelled more than once, despite some common threads.

programme.title: The Tällberg Foundation: 'Jazz for the Planet'
programme.desc: On October 19, 2021, John Patitucci (bass), Marco Pignataro (sax and musical director), and Joe Lovano (sax) showcased inspirational new originals at GBH's Fraser Performance Studio in Boston, MA, accompanied by Terri Lyne Carrington (drums), Nadia Washington (vocals), Chico Pinheiro (guitar), and Anastassiya Petrova (piano).

programme.title: Baden Powell Quartet - Jazz Samba
programme.desc: Recorded in 1971 in Paris, France, Brazilian, classically trained bossa nova guitarist Baden Powell and his quartet play Pai, Lotus (written by Baden Powell), Tristeza (by Haroldo Lobo/Niltinho), Round Midnight (by Thelonious Monk), Nega do cabelo duro (by David Nasser/Rubens Soares), and Aos pes da cruz (by Zé da Zilda/Marino Pinto).

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Arturo Sandoval - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1986, Cuban trumpeter Arturo Sandoval brought his band with him to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Al McKay's Earth, Wind And Fire Experience
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Grégory Privat - SOLEY
programme.desc: Pianist Grégory Privat's 2020 work 'Soley' inhabits a hybrid universe in which voice, piano and synthesizer, Caribbean and electronic music, and the classical and jazz trio traditions coexist and mingle.

programme.title: Marcus Miller: Thoughts on Miles
programme.desc: This portrait of Marcus Miller was recorded during his 2009 ‘Tutu Revisited’ tour. Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. Miller tells us about writing his composition 'Tutu', and shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu'. This documentary was filmed in 2009 at the 'We Want Miles' exhibition in Cité de la Musique in Paris.

programme.title: Herbie Hancock - Sly
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964.

programme.title: Hackensack
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career.

programme.title: SHYRE live at Festival Vue sur la Relève
programme.desc: SHYRE is the creative collaboration launched by Montreal-born vocalist and pianist Sarah Rossy. This five-member group mixes instrumental textures with ethereal ambience, taking the listener on a journey through passages of prose with unique aesthetics. SHYRE fuses pop-folk and jazz with symphonic timbres, and psychedelic ambience, employing lush strings, dynamic rhythms, and angelic harmonies.

programme.title: On Piano
programme.desc: Jazz first gained a foothold on Latvian soil in the 1920s. A century onward, this documentary traces the first two decades of jazz in Latvia in this portrait of Jack Michalicky, the first known Latvian jazz pianist. Michalicky was a musician from head to toe – a gifted violinist, he truly felt at home at the piano. Slender and lithe, the imaginative pianist’s fingers flew across the keys like a true miracle.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians.

programme.title: Fats Domino - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. American singer and pianist Fats Domino gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival of 1980.

programme.title: Edina Mokus - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Art Blakey Live in 1965
programme.desc: Art Blakey: Live in '65 features a very impressive lineup from jazz history: Art Blakey (drums), Jaki Byard (piano), Reggie Workman (bass), Nathan Davis (sax), and the legendary trumpet player, Freddie Hubbard. For a fall tour of Europe, Blakey assembled The New Jazzmen, a short-lived quintet that performed this legendary concert at La Mutualité in Paris on November 3, 1965.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: Linus
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Tania Maria Trio - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Bebop
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: Since You're Gone
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, prominent guitarist George Benson brought his band to kick off day three of the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Duets: Carla Bley and Steve Swallow in 1988
programme.desc: If any two musicians share a special bond when they perform, it’s pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow. The two have performed in the same bands since the 1960s and have been romantic partners for more than two decades. Watching them perform is the definition of musical telepathy. A glance or a smile?seems to change the feel of the music.

programme.title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham And Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers’ came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career.

programme.title: Melody Gardot at Château d'Hérouville
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner’s first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson’s and Art Farmer’s Jazztet.

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Rosenberg meets Beets
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.title: J.E. 'Cannonball' Adderley live in Switzerland
programme.desc: Cannonball Adderley: Live in '63 boasts two beautifully filmed concerts from one of the most celebrated sextets in jazz history, captured at the top of their game.

programme.title: Free Improvisation 2
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1988, vocalist Bobby McFerrin appeared at the festival.

programme.title: Morenika
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen’s trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv’, conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen’s signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Thomas Carbou: Spectacle Au Bleury
programme.desc: Thomas Carbou and Patrick Graham share an almost telepathic rapport, blending spontaneous improvisation, electronic looping, and Brazilian and Indian musical influences to create ecstatic groove pieces and dream-like soundscapes.

programme.title: Fay Claassen: Two Portraits of Chet Baker
programme.desc: In 2013 it is 25 years ago that singer and trumpet player Chet Baker mysteriously died, caused by a fall from the window of his hotel room in Amsterdam. His music is more popular than ever. This concert is performed by Fay Claassen, who became internationally known through her album ‘Two Portraits of Chet Baker’. In the U.S. this album was the ‘Best Vocal Album of the Year’.

programme.title: Dionne Warwick live at the 27 Club
programme.desc: Dionne Warwick’s vocal artistry ranges from voluminous deep register to soft, fragile high notes. She masters the entire range with almost unnerving ease. But more than her strong, warm voice, Dionne’s magic is in the silky elegance and the secure delivery with which she tells a story.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Kyle Eastwood Quintet
programme.desc: Bassist Kyle Eastwood (1968) is an explorer, equally at ease with jazz melodies as with pop songs. In the late 1970s, his father Clint took him to see his first jazz concert - a Count Basie performance. Eastwood Jr. was in awe of the drummer and wanted to play an instrument himself. It so happened he wasn’t so much interested in jazz, preferring rhythm and blues, Motown and Stax records, funk groups, and North African and Indian music.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar).

programme.title: Michel Legrand Orchestra at Spa, 1982
programme.desc: Known outside jazz circles mainly for his film scores, French composer, arranger and pianist Michel Legrand has had a long and storied career in music. Interpreters of his compositions include jazz legends such as Sarah Vaughan, Stan Getz, and Bill Evans, as well as pop stars such as Barbra Streisand and Frank Sinatra.

programme.title: George Shearing: The South Bank Show
programme.desc: George Shearing, blind since birth, is one of the world's greatest jazz pianists. Filmed on both sides of the Atlantic, this tribute to Shearing showcases the music which took the jazz world by storm.

programme.title: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Quartet - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1991, Cuban pianist Gonzalo Rubalcaba was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Jazzed Out Swiss
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: Marion Williams Sings Spirituals
programme.desc: You can’t help but be carried away by the powerful voice Marion Williams, who, with backing from Tommy Brown (piano), Joe Washington (organ), Billy Tuliver (drums), and singers Barbara White and Ann Bolden, sings gospel songs and spirituals as if she has lived them a thousand times over. The repertoire includes such familiar tunes as “Peace in the Valley,” “We Shall Overcome,” and “Michael, Row the Boat Ashore.”.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Kenny Barron, Calypso
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Seine Sessions: Free And Afro Jazz
programme.desc: The term 'jam-session' was born in the 1920s, when black and white musicians gathered in smoke-filled bars after their respective concerts to enjoy the kind of jazz they could not play in traditional sets. Bing Crosby was a regular at these sessions, and had fun marking the first and third beats of musical phrases by clapping hands, which the musicians call 'jammin 'the beat'.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2023 interview
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sly Johnson And Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday.

programme.title: Libérica Arrels
programme.desc: Having played in New York with jazz icons Dave Liebman, Eliot Zigmund, Ari Hoenig, and Chris Cheek, Catalan bass player Manel Fortià now returns to his roots to reinvent traditional Catalan repertoire. Manel Fortià teams up with Antonia Lizana (saxophones), Pere Martínez (vocals), Max Villavecchia (piano), and Raphael Pannier (drums) to form ‘Libérica’, reimagining Catalan music and Flamenco through the eyes of a New York jazz musician.

programme.title: Tim Kliphuis and the NCO: The Changing Seasons
programme.desc: The Netherlands Chamber Orchestra commissioned violinist Tim Kliphuis, internationally known for his genre-crossing approach to music, to write a new version of Antonio Vivaldi's ‘Four Seasons’. Kliphuis choose to take improvisation as his starting point; at the same time, he intended to leave the best-known Vivaldi themes and chords in, as they give the piece its wonderful energy.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jacques Kuba Séguin: L'étude des Lueurs
programme.desc: Trumpeter Jacques Kuba Séguin’s ensemble unites some of Montreal’s most expressive musicians: apart from Jacques Kuba Séguin, double bassist Frédéric Alarie, pianist Jonathan Cayer, and drummer Kevin Warren deliver subtle but strong lyrical moments, that make it hard not to be touched by the musical bond of this group. The experience of their ‘Litania Projekt’ seems to stop time for an instant.

programme.title: Etienne Mbappe - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Sammy Price and his All Star Orchestra
programme.desc: Texan pianist Sammy Price (1908-1992) played everything from blues and boogie-woogie to swing and jump-blues. Starting in Dallas as a singer and dancer in Alphonso Trent’s orchestra, he went to Kansas to form the Texas Bluesicians. At the end of the 1930s, and as a house pianist for the Decca label, he backed many stars, including Sister Rosetta Tharpe and Trixie Smith.

programme.title: TorTube: Robin Nolan Trio - Swing de Paris
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: Seun Kuti And Egypt 80 - Cabaret Sauvage
programme.desc: Seun Anikulapo Kuti possesses the grace, energy and fury of his father, the legendary artist Fela Kuti. With the musicians of Fela Kuti’s legendary band Egypt 80, Seaun Kuti brings the most original incarnation of Afrobeat to life. Digging deep into different African traditions, Seun has brought his own touch to the music by reflecting the difficulties and cultures of the continent.

programme.title: Samba das Flores - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: MEGA Fights T1 - Ep. 42
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features welterweights 'Sugar' Shane Mosley (43-4, 37 KOs) and Luis Collazo (27-2, 13 KOs) fighting over the interim WBC title. This fight took place at the Mandalay Bay Resort and Casino in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA, on February 10, 2007.

programme.title: BWF Martial Arts T9 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: This episode features highlights from the Women's Forms Championship at the ISKA US Open Championships held at Disney World, Orlando, FL, USA.

programme.title: Judo for the World T1 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode we see the best Judo from the Tokyo Grand Slam where the home nation is looking to dominate as they fielded 7 of Japan's 8 world champions. Plus we catch up with Japan's brother and sister superstars, the Abe's.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 39
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Andre Berto defending the WBC welterweight title against former WBA champion Luis Collazo. Each fighter had their own share of getting stunned throughout the bout, and the judges' decision at the end will have some controversy. Also on the card, kickboxing takes center stage as super heavyweight legend Daniel Ghita takes on Gokhan Saki.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T26 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. From the Ryogoku Kokugikan Arena in Tokyo, Japan, Show 1 features Kotoshoho, Terunofuji, Hokutofuji and Tochinoshin.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights T3 - Ep. 41
programme.desc: Wide World Of Fights includes all styles of fighting from around the world in one show! This episode features a Heavyweight bout between an once-beaten Amir Mansour and big-hitting Fred Kassi, as well as kickboxing, sumo and more!.

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles 'Sonny' Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Unfortunately, just eight years later, he was found dead in his Las Vegas home from an alleged heroin overdose. Suspicion regarding the real cause of his death has continued to this day. Episode 3 of 4.

Quando terroristas tentam assumir o controle de um voo Berlim-Paris, um co-piloto americano de fala mansa luta para salvar a vida dos passageiros e da tripulação enquanto forja uma conexão surpreendente com um dos sequestradores.

programme.title: Signs Of A Psychopath T2 - Ep. 18

programme.title: Reerguer Notre Dame T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Cinco anos depois do incêndio devastador, este documentário tem acesso exclusivo à reconstrução da catedral de Notre Dame. A igreja história entra na fase final do seu processo de restauro no valor de mil milhões de dólares. Os trabalhos de reconstrução do monumento estão na fase final e as equipas correm contra o tempo para ter tudo pronto para a reabertura ao público no final deste ano.

programme.title: Testemunhos Do Desastre T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: A história do maior incêndio na história de Portugal e de como este devastou uma comunidade rural. Enquanto os bombeiros tentavam controlá-lo, juntam-se ao incêndio os ventos fortes de uma tempestade. Rapidamente se tornou incontrolável. Os habitantes locais foram apanhados neste inferno. 205 ficaram feridos, 66 mortos.

programme.title: Tucci Em Itália T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Stanley descobre como a adversidade moldou esta região emblemática, revelando que a sua história marcada por dificuldades deu origem a inovações culinárias criativas.

programme.title: Tucci Em Itália T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Stanley descobre que a Sicília é uma ilha de contrastes e influências múltiplas, onde a história multicultural deixou uma marca deliciosa na gastronomia e nas gentes.

programme.title: Tucci Em Itália T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Stanley explora os tesouros gastronómicos desta região menos conhecida e questiona-se como é que tantas maravilhas passaram despercebidas aos turistas internacionais.

programme.title: Tucci Em Itália T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Stanley mergulha nos mitos e mistérios desta ilha selvagem, descobrindo uma gastronomia tão singular quanto a sua geografia.

programme.title: A Ciência Da Estupidez T2 - Ep. 26
programme.desc: Neste episódio, aprenderemos quantas maneiras há de se embaraçar, lesionar e humilhar enquanto tenta parar enquanto escala um poste de iluminação, tentar um 'move' de break dance ou andar de skate fora de estrada.

programme.title: A Ciência Da Estupidez T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Neste episódio Richard Hammond explora o potencial humilhante e doloroso das manobras de scooter, do break dance e de nos balouçarmos em cordas.

programme.title: Imundícies Preciosas T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Há muito dinheiro para ser encontrado na parte selvagem da América. Nas montanhas da Appalachia, Billy Taylor e os seus filhos acabaram de receber uma encomenda online de mais de 3 quilos de ginseng selvagem.

programme.title: Europa Vista De Cima T6 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Esta série de viagens aéreas espetaculares revela as paisagens mais notáveis da Riviera polaca de uma forma nunca antes vista. Desde um gigantesco porto de contentores e um vibrante mercado de Natal do Báltico em Gdansk até um espetáculo de luzes que muda a realidade na cidade de Torun. Também viajaremos através da notável península de Helsandbar e conheceremos os segredos de uma grande fábrica abandonada.

programme.title: Europa Vista De Cima T6 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Esta série de viagens aéreas espetaculares revela as paisagens mais notáveis da Lapónia de uma forma nunca antes vista. Câmaras voadoras revelam a espetacular cidade de Malmberget, um passeio emocionante num navio quebra-gelo no mar de Bótnia, e uma viagem à antiga cidade-igreja de Gammelstad And Hägnan durante o seu famoso mercado de Natal.

programme.title: Europa Vista De Cima T4 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Uma vista aérea da Escócia revela um incrível projeto de energia das marés, um majestoso castelo no topo de um penhasco e o primeiro campo de golfe do mundo.

programme.title: De Polo A Polo Com Will Smith T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Acompanhado pela linguista Mary Walworth e pelo ecólogo marinho local John Aini, Will viaja até ao Pacífico Sul numa expedição a uma ilha remota ameaçada pela subida do nível do mar. O que começa como a exploração de um paraíso marinho transforma-se numa viagem reveladora sobre a própria história de Will, enquanto registam uma língua em risco de desaparecer, falada por apenas cinco pessoas.

programme.title: De Polo A Polo Com Will Smith T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Will mergulha no deserto do Kalahari para conhecer o povo San, um dos grupos de caçadores-recolectores mais antigos do planeta. Para descobrir o segredo da sua sobrevivência ao longo dos milénios, junta-se a eles numa caçada num dos ambientes mais inóspitos da Terra. Liderado pelo guia San Kane Motswana, depressa percebe que está longe de estar preparado para este desafio.

programme.title: De Polo A Polo Com Will Smith T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: A etapa final da aventura de 100 dias de Will é a mais perigosa de todas: uma expedição para mergulhar sob o gelo do Polo Norte e ajudar a ecóloga polar Allison Fong a recolher amostras científicas inéditas. Porém, quando uma tempestade de neve e uma avaria mecânica colocam a missão em risco, Will aprende o verdadeiro significado de ser um herói na vida real.

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T2 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Uma tempestade inesperada força Colbert a abandonar a expedição de pesca, uma reparação de tecto transforma-se num teste para as mulas de Derik, Thorn parte para a caça a meio da noite e a fonte de água de Tobias está a desaparecer..

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T2 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: O projeto de Tony e Amelia fica fora de controlo, as mulas turbulentas de Derik escapam do curral, Thorn é engenhoso com uma morte por atropelamento. A fonte de água de Tobias fica seca e Colbert tem que trabalhar lesionado para terminar a sua cabine..

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Nos pântanos frios da Geórgia, Colbert enfrenta vários meses de Inverno duro pela frente. Ele apercebe-se que a sua chance de apanhar carne está a chegar ao fim e um Inverno a tentar arranjar proteína seria extenuante, especialmente para o explorador veterano. Num local remoto no sul do Utah, Matt regressa a casa e descobre que o terreno mudou.

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T3 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Há apenas alguns dias restantes da caça ao veado nas Blue Ridge Mountains da Carolina do Norte e os caseiros Tony e Amelia precisam de carne para os sustentar pelo Inverno. Mas Tony nunca caçou veado e não tem o luxo do tempo para aperfeiçoar os seus métodos. Tony entra diretamente na caçada e a pressão começa.

programme.title: Penas Pesadas: Dilemas E Consequências T3 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: A prisão é uma batalha constante entre o caos e o controlo. A segurar essa linha está uma equipa de agentes experientes e habilidosos. Quebre as regras na prisão e a punição é severa. Isto é, se for apanhado. Este é o mundo dos reclusos rebeldes e determinados a encontrar maneiras de enganar o sistema. Alguns safam-se. A maioria, apesar da experiência, sofre as consequências..

programme.title: Penas Pesadas: Dilemas E Consequências T3 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Las Vegas não é chamada a Cidade do Pecado por acaso. Quer esteja de visita ou seja residente, a cultura do sexo, drogas e violência é difícil de evitar. A prisão do condado já viu de tudo: de bêbedos aos gritos até gang bangers. É um local onde a festa chega ao fim, onde as salas de espera se transformam em centros de desintoxicação e turistas transformam-se em prisioneiros.

programme.title: Penas Pesadas: Dilemas E Consequências T3 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: A unidade feminina da prisão do condado de Las Vegas não é para pessoas facilmente impressionáveis. Duas mulheres, ambas mães, são acusadas de assassinato e ambas recusam-se a confessar. Em vez disso, arriscam o julgamento. Enquanto aguardam pelo seu destino, têm de enfrentar as prisioneiras hostis da infame ala feminina.

programme.title: Penas Pesadas: Dilemas E Consequências T3 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Dois reclusos normais no Centro de Detenção do Condado de Clark, em Las Vegas, estão a ter dificuldades com o vício. Ambos estão desesperados por uma segunda oportunidade e enfrentarão as provas da Cidade .

programme.title: Resgate Abaixo De Zero T10 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Bjoern planeia um resgate de alto risco quando um camião-tanque capotado bloqueia a estrada, enquanto Raido lida com um dos maiores camiões da Noruega.

programme.title: Yukon: Operação De Resgate T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: As temperaturas gélidas causam estragos em Dawson City, colocando o corpo de bombeiros em perigo. Uma avalanche fecha a Klondike Highway e um motorista de reboque corre contra o tempo para encontrar um condutor que caiu da estrada para um rio gelado.

programme.title: Yukon: Operação De Resgate T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Várias chamadas para o 112 levam Dawson City ao limite, enquanto os socorristas lutam para salvar a casa de uma família e um edifício histórico, ao mesmo tempo que tempestades de neve atingem Whitehorse, provocando o caos e obrigando a uma perigosa missão de resgate de helicóptero numa área remota.

programme.title: Yukon: Operação De Resgate T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: À medida que o inverno aperta, a pequena e isolada comunidade de West Dawson fica completamente desprovida de serviços de emergência. Sozinho, Ray enfrenta uma série de perigosas missões de recuperação de veículos numa autoestrada fustigada pela tempestade.

programme.title: Yukon: Operação De Resgate T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Técnicos de prevenção de avalanches correm para reparar uma estação meteorológica remota antes de uma tempestade iminente. O aumento dos riscos obriga-os a uma missão de bombardeamento para eliminar uma acumulação perigosa de neve sobre a Klondike Highway. Entretanto, Dawson City fica em choque com a perda da pessoa em quem mais confiavam para os manter seguros.

programme.title: SOS Automóvel T14 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Tim e Fuzz enfrentam uma missão ousada: resgatar um Frogeye Sprite escondido numa garagem há mais de 50 anos, agora enferrujado, bloqueado e em mau estado. Com um serralheiro a caminho, conseguirão restaurá-lo a tempo de uma emocionante revelação numa vinha, com a ajuda surpresa de Dame Joanna Lumley? O tempo urge.

programme.title: SOS Automóvel T14 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Tim e Fuzz trabalham num Mercedes SLK com enorme valor sentimental para a dona, Lili. Mas este elegante roadster esconde grandes mistérios: por que razão não arranca e porque é que o seu inovador teto dobrável ficou preso aberto? Enquanto Fuzz enfrenta os “gremlins” da oficina, Tim viaja até à Alemanha em busca de respostas, a correr contra o tempo rumo a uma revelação de grande impacto no West End.

programme.title: SOS Automóvel T14 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Tim e Fuzz trabalham num Mini Mayfair extremamente degradado, que havia sido comprado por Donna com a herança do falecido pai. Ela sonhava com um Cooper, mas acabou com um carro enferrujado, e os seus problemas de saúde impediram qualquer restauro. Agora, os rapazes terão de restaurar o que resta e transformar o carro num verdadeiro tributo ao Cooper, com a ajuda da própria família Cooper.

programme.title: SOS Automóvel T14 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Tim e Fuzz enfrentam um dos maiores desafios de sempre: um Golf GTi Mk1 pertencente a um dos maiores fãs da VW em Birmingham. Ao contrário das restaurações anteriores, este não é um simples restauro; é uma missão para criar um carro de sonho que impressione no encontro de automóveis mais importante do Reino Unido. Conseguirão surpreender o público?.

programme.title: SOS Automóvel T12 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Tim e Fuzz estão a caminho dos condados domésticos, onde têm à sua espera um Ford Popular de 1955. Contudo, este não é um clássico vulgar, mas sim um hot-rod altamente modificado com um motor V8 brutal e uma série de problemas. O carro já foi a menina dos olhos de Andy, que sofre de paralisia cerebral, mas com tantos problemas mecânicos o seu adorado Pop tem estado a apanhar pó na garagem sem qualquer chance de voltar à estrada.

programme.title: SOS Automóvel T12 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Tim e Fuzz restauram um Datsun Skyline, um clássico japonês dos anos 70. Com apenas outros dois exemplares na estrada, este é um dos carros mais raros em que a dupla já trabalhou.

programme.title: Mega Fábricas T5 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Aproveite esta impressionante oportunidade de ver como se produz um Ford Mustang, onde são feitas quatro versões diferentes, incluindo o super poderoso V8 de 650 cavalos.

programme.title: Mega Fábricas T5 - Ep. 19
programme.desc: Em 2011, quase uma década depois do lançamento do Murcielago, a Lamborghini lança a sua criação mais recente - o Aventador. Com uma velocidade máxima de 350km/h e manobrabilidade melhorada, este carro é um símbolo da nova era da Lamborghini. Veja a história por detrás da ideia e conceito até ao produto final, acompanhando o incrível processo de produção, num edifício de tamanho impressionante, inteiramente dedicado ao Aventador.

programme.title: Mayday, Desastres Aéreos T25 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Quando o trem de aterragem falha, os pilotos de um turboélice da Nova Zelândia realizam uma notável aterragem de barriga que salva a vida de todos a bordo e causa danos mínimos à aeronave. Ao investigar o que correu mal, os especialistas descobrem um problema sistémico que está a pôr passageiros em risco em todo o mundo.

programme.title: Bastidores: Aeroporto De Toronto T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Aviões congelados, uma assistente de voo ferida e um intruso embriagado mantêm a equipa em alerta máximo quando uma grande onda de frio atinge o Aeroporto Internacional de Toronto.

programme.title: Bastidores: Aeroporto De Toronto T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Uma emergência na pista, carga desaparecida, travões avariados e animais na pista – no Aeroporto Internacional de Toronto, a luta para manter os voos em movimento nunca tem fim.

programme.title: Bastidores: Aeroporto De Toronto T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Um avião aterra de emergência no Aeroporto Internacional de Toronto. O consequente encerramento do aeroporto faz com que voos sejam cancelados e desviados, testando os limites das equipas.

programme.title: Mayday, Desastres Aéreos T25 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Um avião turboélice fora de controlo desintegra-se durante uma tentativa de aterragem no aeroporto de Düsseldorf, matando instantaneamente todos os ocupantes. Os investigadores alemães localizam todos os destroços no local do acidente e, após uma meticulosa reconstrução da fuselagem, descobrem provas de uma falha extremamente rara que nunca deveria ter feito cair o avião.

programme.title: A Ciência Da Estupidez T2 - Ep. 28
programme.desc: Alguma vez escorregou no gelo e se perguntou porquê? Alguma vez ficou perplexo pela sua falha ao atirar um Frisbee ou passou algumas noites sem dormir a pensar porquê é que o seu salto de BMX acabou numa visita o hospital? Bem, a ajuda está a postos quando Richard Hammond regressa para uma segunda temporada de Science of Stupid.

programme.title: Imundícies Preciosas T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Quando a fornalha, que fornece energia ao seu fumador, se avaria, toda a operação de Ray fica estagnada. No Louisiana, os rapazes do bayou, David LaGrange, Keith e Seth Major estão no encalce de um aligátore gigante que lhes tem andado a roubar o isco e a dar um prejuízo de milhares de dólares.

programme.title: Europa Vista De Cima T4 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Uma viagem aérea sobre a Dinamarca revela uma central elétrica com uma pista de esqui como telhado, casas tradicionais feitas de zostera e uma nova conexão europeia.

programme.title: Europa Vista De Cima T4 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Uma viagem aérea sobre a Sérvia revela um arranha-céus recorde, uma maneira única de colher pimentos e um esforço especial de conservação animal.

programme.title: Europa Vista De Cima T4 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Uma viagem aérea sobre a Bélgica mostra um edifício em forma de cristal de ferro, a limpeza da maior igreja do país e um evento de luzes que acontece a cada três anos.

programme.title: Profecias Da História T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: O astrólogo Nostradamus escreveu centenas de versos enigmáticos que parecem prever acontecimentos futuros. Segundo a lenda, o Castelo de Houska guarda um portal para o inferno e foi ali que o poeta Mácha teve uma visão aterradora do futuro. Na Itália medieval, São Francisco de Assis afirmou ter vivido o primeiro caso de estigmas, acreditando ter recebido as chagas de Cristo.

programme.title: Profecias Da História T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: As visões de Rasputine e a sua alegada capacidade de cura valeram-lhe uma reputação que o levou ao círculo íntimo do último czar e a um lugar nas páginas da história. Na China, estudiosos procuram decifrar os segredos de uma escrita antiga e de um sistema de adivinhação. Em Point Pleasant, na Virgínia Ocidental, uma misteriosa criatura alada foi avistada pouco antes do colapso trágico de uma ponte.

programme.title: Profecias Da História T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Na China do século XIV, o brilhante Liu Bowen coloca os seus talentos e profecias ao serviço de uma dinastia em ascensão. Depois de se declarar ditador de Roma, Júlio César recebe uma profecia inquietante. Porque é que não deu ouvidos aos avisos? Na Escócia, a família nobre Erskine recebe uma profecia que os persegue como uma maldição durante gerações.

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T3 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Há apenas alguns dias restantes da caça ao veado nas Blue Ridge Mountains da Carolina do Norte e os caseiros Tony e Amelia precisam de carne para os sustentar pelo Inverno. Mas Tony nunca caçou veado e não tem o luxo do tempo para aperfeiçoar os seus métodos. Tony entra diretamente na caçada e a pressão começa.

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T3 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Estamos na temporada das armadilhas e Colbert tem que meter mãos à obra. Vender peles de castor na cidades dar-lhe-á o grosso do dinheiro para pagar os impostos dos seus terrenos e servirá para comprar itens pequenos que não consegue arranjar no pântano. O caçador-coletor Matt tenta caçar coelhos com o seu arco e flecha caseiro.

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T3 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Os caseiros Tony e Amelia começam a construção de um desidratador solar para preservar a abundância de carne de veado. Com o seu design a existir apenas na mente de Tony, o par tem que juntar vários materiais reciclados e reaproveitados para construir o aparato de uma maneira que capitalize toda a energia solar que consegue. A falta de recursos por perto força o caçador-coletor Matt a deixar a sua casa em busca de pastos mais verdes.

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Após abandonar a sua antiga casa devido à falta de recursos, o caçador-recolector Matt viaja até aos desfiladeiros de elevação inferior do sul do Utah para encontrar um novo local para chamar de casa. Ele tem esperança que esta terra tenha os recursos necessários para sobreviver nos meses frios. O Inverno chegou finalmente portanto Matt tem que trabalhar rapidamente para construir um abrigo permanente para se proteger dos elementos.

programme.title: Penas Pesadas: Dilemas E Consequências T3 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Dois reclusos normais no Centro de Detenção do Condado de Clark, em Las Vegas, estão a ter dificuldades com o vício. Ambos estão desesperados por uma segunda oportunidade e enfrentarão as provas da Cidade .

programme.title: Penas Pesadas: Dilemas E Consequências T3 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Para três reclusos do Centro de Detenção do Condado de Clark, a prisão é um jogo de espera - um relógio a contar em cima das suas cabeças que os levará ou a mais tempo na prisão ou à vida de volta nas ruas. Em Vegas, sair da prisão é, por vezes, a parte fácil. Mas manter-se fora é uma história muito diferente. Com nada além de tempo, os reclusos são forçados a escolher se querem continuar no mesmo caminho ou mudar de vida..

programme.title: Penas Pesadas: Dilemas E Consequências T4 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Las Vegas é um oásis de trabalho e diversão, quer legais quer ilegais. Desrespeite a lei e será enviado para o Centro de Detenção do condado de Clark, a principal prisão da cidade do pecado. Quando os reclusos cumprem pena na prisão, a família cumpre pena cá fora. Alguns reclusos libertam-se do que os aprisiona em termos mentais e físicos e voltam às suas famílias. Outros sucumbem aos vícios e voltam à estaca zero..

programme.title: Penas Pesadas: Dilemas E Consequências T4 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: No centro de detenção de Clark Country, em Las Vegas, mais de mil reclusos dão entrada sob o efeito de drogas, com doenças mentais ou ambos. Por vezes é impossível ignorar que este estabelecimento será também um centro de reabilitação para toxicodependentes e um hospital psiquiátrico. Estes reclusos não são só um problema para a cadeia, são também da sua responsabilidade.

programme.title: Yukon: Operação De Resgate T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Técnicos de prevenção de avalanches correm para reparar uma estação meteorológica remota antes de uma tempestade iminente. O aumento dos riscos obriga-os a uma missão de bombardeamento para eliminar uma acumulação perigosa de neve sobre a Klondike Highway. Entretanto, Dawson City fica em choque com a perda da pessoa em quem mais confiavam para os manter seguros.

programme.title: Yukon: Operação De Resgate T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: A Civil Air Search and Rescue Association do Yukon enfrenta condições de voo traiçoeiras na investigação de um avião histórico desaparecido. O Corpo de Bombeiros de Dawson City responde a uma chamada de emergência que coloca a cidade em risco, enquanto dois dos seus elementos ficam em apuros longe de casa. Depois, um pedido de ajuda leva Ray às zonas mais remotas do Yukon.

programme.title: Yukon: Operação De Resgate T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: O Corpo de Bombeiros de Dawson City corre para proteger a cidade de inundações repentinas e devastadoras. Os guardas-florestais perseguem uma manada de bisontes perigosa, têm um encontro com um urso e montam uma operação para apanhar um pescador furtivo reincidente. Ray e Doug enfrentam um lamaçal ao resgatar o veículo avariado de um caçador.

programme.title: Yukon: Operação De Resgate T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: O guarda-florestal Logan apanha um grande susto ao investigar um caso de caça ilegal, e um urso-pardo agressivo devasta a cabana remota de um caçador. Ray entra em ação quando um condutor adormece ao volante, e uma nova geração de recrutas da Yukon First Nations Wildfire é posta à prova quando um incêndio ameaça Whitehorse.

programme.title: Yukon: Operação De Resgate T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Quando um urso investe contra um grupo de investigadores num local remoto, um guarda-florestal enfrenta uma situação potencialmente fatal. Mais tarde, o Corpo de Bombeiros de Dawson City dá resposta ao acidente de um rapaz num trilho de BTT e a uma colisão numa ravina, antes de ser homenageado pelo Chefe Mike e por toda a cidade pelo seu serviço.

programme.title: Tsunami: Corrida Contra O Tempo T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Um tsunami atinge o Sri Lanka. A mais de 1000 milhas do epicentro do terramoto, as ondas destroem um comboio e cidades costeiras. Os médicos lutam para salvar todas as vidas que podem. À medida que o desastre se espalha por todo o Oceano Índico, os jornalistas correm para dar a notícia ao mundo e as pessoas acordam para a realidade devastadora de que os seus entes queridos foram arrastados.

programme.title: Tsunami: Corrida Contra O Tempo T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: No rescaldo do tsunami mais mortífero da história, os turistas ficam retidos numa ilha devastada pela força das ondas. Com centenas de vítimas, os sobreviventes, oriundos de todos os cantos do mundo têm de trabalhar em conjunto para salvar vidas. Contra todas as probabilidades, conseguem efetuar alguns dos salvamentos mais miraculosos do dia.

programme.title: Bastidores: Aeroporto De Toronto T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Uma grande tempestade atinge o Aeroporto Internacional de Toronto. As equipas correm contra o tempo para remover a neve e deslocar um Boeing 787 atravessado na pista, que está a causar o caos nas portas de embarque.

programme.title: Libertação: Do Dia D A Berlim T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Novas imagens coloridas e testemunhos revelam o verdadeiro preço pago pelos Aliados e pelos civis para libertar a Bélgica e os Países Baixos da ocupação nazi.

programme.title: Libertação: Do Dia D A Berlim T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: No final de 1944, Hitler obriga os americanos a travarem a maior e mais sangrenta batalha da guerra, quando lança um ataque surpresa à Bélgica já livre do domínio nazi.

programme.title: Libertação: Do Dia D A Berlim T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Imagens coloridas únicas e testemunhos orais revelam o custo da libertação da Europa Ocidental no último ano da Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Mega Fábricas T5 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Um olhar mais aprofundado pelas mais variadas marcas do mundo inteiro, e uma incrível viagem através da linha de montagem em cada uma destas autênticas Mega Fábricas.

programme.desc: Um retrato sobre vários dos dias decisivos na guerra, como o Dia D na Normandia, e a batalha de Saipan..

Mariana volta a não ir para o Brasil por causa da família.

Reportagens no local, entrevistas em direto e sempre a isenção e o respeito pela verdade que marcam a informação na RTP.

programme.title: Vila Faia - Ep. 103
programme.desc: Ainda não sabem se Gonçalo voltará a andar. Nuno e Luísa confessam, perante Ifigénia e Pedro, que, antes do acidente, contaram a Gonçalo que arranjaram outro comprador para a Castelão. Ifigénia acusa Nuno de ser um banana. Sofia continua a achar que Henrique é um Marques Vila. Nuno enfrenta Luísa. Ana desconfia que foi Luísa quem matou Gaspar. Alice repreende Gudunha por ter participado num combate. Zé Diniz despede-se da clínica.

programme.title: Portugal Em Rede
programme.desc: Programa de informação centrado no país e nas regiões. Revelar o Portugal que existe para além das grandes cidades, do norte ao sul e às ilhas, numa verdadeira rede de informação. Inclui um segmento dedicado à língua portuguesa e à sua promoção 'Esta língua que nos une'. Os Centros de Informação Regional terão uma participação relevante neste espaço, onde a sociedade, cultura, história e tradições portuguesas vão estar sempre presentes.

programme.title: O Preço Certo
programme.desc: Há mais de duas décadas em emissão contínua na RTP1, 'O Preço Certo', é o gameshow de maior longevidade da televisão mundial. Estreado pela primeira vez em 1956 nos Estados Unidos, já foi transmitido em mais de 30 países. O sucesso por todo o mundo é testemunho da sua contínua popularidade e vitalidade, provando ser um clássico e intemporal formato de programas de entretenimento.

programme.title: Telejornal
programme.desc: A mais rigorosa seleção de notícias, todos os dias às 20h00. De segunda a domingo, João Adelino Faria, José Rodrigues dos Santos e Ana Lourenço mostram-lhe o que de mais relevante se passou o país e no mundo. Se é importante está no Telejornal.

programme.title: Joker T11 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Vasco Palmeirim apresenta o JOKER, o concurso favorito dos portugueses. Um concorrente, com a ajuda de 7 Jokers e do Super Joker, responde a 12 perguntas com um só objetivo em mente: Conquistar os 50 000 euros do prémio máximo!.

programme.title: Grande Debate - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A crise energética e os desafios do futuro elétrico. A análise no Grande Debate, com moderação de Carlos Daniel. Da mobilidade à indústria, a economia está num processo de eletrificação sem precedentes. Mas a procura de energia não para de crescer, acelerada pela digitalização e agravada pelas necessidades dos centros de dados, que são os cérebros da inteligência artificial. O caminho não se prevê fácil.

programme.title: Fora De Série - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Talk show que pretende acompanhar tudo o que Portugal anda a ver, ouvir e comentar. Concertos e séries que marcam, estreias de cinema, lançamento de músicas, livros e exposições. Com ritmo, humor e curiosidade, Vanessa Oliveira e José Carlos Malato, os nossos apresentadores, recebem convidados para conversas sobre os projetos, as ideias e as histórias que estão a transformar o panorama criativo.
